allowed_background_endpoints.purpose: Fetch signed Chromium component update metadata
allowed_background_endpoints.owner: Google LLC upstream Chromium component service
allowed_background_endpoints.payload_class: component identifiers, installed versions, platform and update cohort metadata; no page URLs
allowed_background_endpoints.retention: Ahoi stores no request payload; upstream service retention applies
allowed_background_endpoints.disable_behavior: Disabling component updates stops this request and also stops security component refreshes
allowed_background_endpoints.failure_behavior: Keep the last verified component and retry with Chromium component-updater backoff

allowed_background_endpoints.purpose: Download a signed component selected by component metadata
allowed_background_endpoints.owner: Google LLC upstream Chromium component CDN
allowed_background_endpoints.payload_class: signed CRX component bytes selected by verified update metadata
allowed_background_endpoints.retention: Ahoi retains only the verified installed component; CDN retention applies externally
allowed_background_endpoints.disable_behavior: Disabling component updates stops downloads and also stops security component refreshes
allowed_background_endpoints.failure_behavior: Reject incomplete or invalid signatures, retain the last verified component and retry later

allowed_background_endpoints.purpose: Download a signed component after the Chromium CDN redirect
allowed_background_endpoints.owner: Google LLC upstream Chromium component CDN
allowed_background_endpoints.payload_class: signed CRX component bytes selected by verified update metadata
allowed_background_endpoints.retention: Ahoi retains only the verified installed component; CDN retention applies externally
allowed_background_endpoints.disable_behavior: Disabling component updates stops downloads and also stops security component refreshes
allowed_background_endpoints.failure_behavior: A plaintext capture blocks release; reject incomplete or invalid signatures, retain the last verified component and retry later

allowed_background_endpoints.owner: Google LLC upstream Safe Browsing service
allowed_background_endpoints.payload_class: Standard Protection threat-list updates and hash-prefix lookups; no Ahoi account data
allowed_background_endpoints.retention: Ahoi retains local threat-list state only; upstream Safe Browsing retention applies
allowed_background_endpoints.disable_behavior: User or enterprise opt-out disables lookups and visibly reduces protection
allowed_background_endpoints.failure_behavior: Use the last valid local list, fail without bypassing certificate or download protections, and retry with backoff

allowed_background_endpoints.owner: Google LLC upstream Safe Browsing service
allowed_background_endpoints.payload_class: Standard Protection threat-list updates and hash-prefix lookups; no Ahoi account data
allowed_background_endpoints.retention: Ahoi retains local threat-list state only; upstream Safe Browsing retention applies
allowed_background_endpoints.disable_behavior: User or enterprise opt-out disables lookups and visibly reduces protection
allowed_background_endpoints.failure_behavior: Use the last valid local list, fail without bypassing certificate or download protections, and retry with backoff

conditional_endpoints.purpose: Signed AhoiBrowser Sparkle appcast; absent until release configuration supplies it
conditional_endpoints.owner: AhoiBrowser release operator configured by the release environment
conditional_endpoints.payload_class: public release version, download URL, checksum and signature metadata
conditional_endpoints.retention: Ahoi retains installed-version metadata only; configured feed-host retention applies externally
conditional_endpoints.disable_behavior: An absent feed URL disables update checks and keeps the current installation usable
conditional_endpoints.failure_behavior: Reject unsigned or invalid metadata, retain the installed version and surface update failure
